parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: 规则描述信息，最长500个字符

parameters.name: ErrorHandlers
parameters.description: 质量规则校验问题处理器列表

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: 规则名称，数字、英文字母、汉字、半角全角标点符号组合，最长255个字符

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。

parameters.name: Severity
parameters.description:
规则对于业务的等级（对应页面上的强弱规则），可选的枚举值：
- Normal
- High

parameters.name: TemplateCode
parameters.description: 规则所引用的规则模板唯一标识

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public update-data-quality-rule --id 100001 --name The_table_cannot_be_empty. --enabled true --severity High --description this_is_a_odps_sql_task --project-id 10000 --template-code SYSTEM:table:table_count:fixed --sampling-config SettingConfig=SET_odps.sql.udf.timeout=600s_SET_odps.sql.python.version=cp27 SamplingFilter=id_IS_NULL Metric=Min MetricParameters=Columns_:_id_,_name_,_SQL_:_select_count_1_from_table --checking-config '{"Type":"Fixed","Thresholds":{"Expected":{"Operator":"example-string","Expression":"checkValue_=_0.01","Value":"100.0"},"Warned":{"Operator":"example-string","Expression":"checkValue_0.01","Value":"100.0"},"Critical":{"Operator":"example-string","Expression":"checkValue_0.05","Value":"100.0"}},"ReferencedSamplesFilter":"bizdate_:_-1_,_-7_,_-1m"}' --error-handlers Type=SaveErrorData ErrorDataFilter=SELECT_0_FROM_tb_api_log_WHERE_id_IS_NULL --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public UpdateDataQualityRule --region cn-hangzhou --TemplateCode 'SYSTEM:table:table_count:fixed' --Description this_is_a_odps_sql_task --CheckingConfig '{"Type":"Fixed","Thresholds":{"Expected":{"Operator":"example-string","Expression":"checkValue_=_0.01","Value":"100.0"},"Warned":{"Operator":"example-string","Expression":"checkValue_0.01","Value":"100.0"},"Critical":{"Operator":"example-string","Expression":"checkValue_0.05","Value":"100.0"}},"ReferencedSamplesFilter":"bizdate_:_-1_,_-7_,_-1m"}' --ProjectId 10000 --Enabled true --Severity High --Id 100001 --SamplingConfig '{"SettingConfig":"SET_odps.sql.udf.timeout=600s_SET_odps.sql.python.version=cp27","SamplingFilter":"id_IS_NULL","Metric":"Min","MetricParameters":"Columns_:_id_,_name_,_SQL_:_select_count_1_from_table"}' --ErrorHandlers '[{"Type":"SaveErrorData","ErrorDataFilter":"SELECT_0_FROM_tb_api_log_WHERE_id_IS_NULL"}]' --Name 'The_table_cannot_be_empty.'
